brief: Three close gameplay-camera panels: derelict tiled ghost station, broken rail Turkish bathhouse, trashed animatronic banquet; acid green smoke/glow, UV graffiti, litter, damp peeling tiles, flicker, readable jumps. Batman & Robin abandoned Turkish baths and Scooby-Doo Spooky Island visual references.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one wide three-panel environment art direction sheet for a playable low-poly 3D indoor ghost train game. Primary request: a much more atmospheric, fun, campy derelict haunted castle ride, taking visual cues from the abandoned neon-graffiti Turkish bathhouse in Batman & Robin (1997) and Scooby-Doo Spooky Island's haunted ride. The three equal panels are real-time low-poly game-render mockups from a close third-person gameplay camera, no character or UI. Panel 1: wrecked station in a once-grand tiled bath hall, battered compact monster-faced burgundy carts, broken railway over a sunken pool, bent boarding signs, garbage bags, cans, torn ticket posters, exposed corroded pipes and a suspended axe. Panel 2: a ruined Turkish bath chamber crossed by interrupted elevated grind rails and stepping ledges; peeling cream and turquoise mosaic tiles, cracked horseshoe arches, damp black stains, thick green steam pooling below the clear playable rails, lime-green light pouring out of broken grates, violet UV graffiti and one flickering neon fixture. Panel 3: a trashed animatronic banquet stage, tilted tables, menacing cakes and turkey automata, a robotic knight with brilliant green eyes, missing tiles and litter, green backlit steam obscuring the far monster-mouth door. Dramatic large shape silhouettes, asymmetrical mess and layered near/mid/far depth. Acid emerald glow is the dominant light, deep teal shadows, restrained magenta/coral practicals; visible luminous halos and lit drifting smoke. Surfaces feel weathered and wet. Keep routes and jump landing pads clearly readable. Detailed painted low-poly materials, strong theatrical colour, plausible browser game geometry. No pristine symmetrical empty hall, no generic dungeon, no photorealism, no labels, no branding, no watermark.
